meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把散落在 .env 里的密钥搬进统一保险库,并完成命令行工具的首次初始化配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚装好命令行工具,想把项目里的密钥从 .env 收进保险库
copy.tagline_en: Migrate scattered .env credentials into a managed vault and finish first-time setup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed a CLI tool and want its .env secrets moved into a vault

howto.what: 它会安装 OneCLI 和它的 CLI、配置 Agent Vault 网关,把 .env 里已有的 Anthropic 等凭据迁移进保险库,并从 .env 删掉这些明文密钥,最后重建、重启服务并查日志确认接入成功。
howto.when: 在 `/update-nanoclaw` 把 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入之后运行,或你首次从零搭建 OneCLI 时接管。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault
say.note: 安装网关并把 .env 里的凭据迁移进保险库

say.text: 重新配置 OneCLI,从头装一遍再注册密钥
say.note: 重装并按你选的订阅或 API key 方式注册凭据

say.text: 列出 OneCLI 里现在有哪些密钥
say.note: 执行 onecli secrets list 查看结果

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI and its CLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates existing .env credentials into the vault, removes the plaintext keys from .env, then rebuilds and restarts the service and checks logs for a working gateway.
howto.when_en: Run after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for a first-time OneCLI setup from scratch.

say_en.text: Set up OneCLI Agent Vault for me
say_en.note: Installs the gateway and migrates .env credentials
